dedupe_keys.name: wdn sa benchmark structural diagnostic benchmark generator

description: wdn-sa-benchmark converts water-distribution networks into structural diagnostic benchmarks. Its EpanetConverter accepts EPANET INP files and selected pressure sensors, flow sensors, leaks and sensor faults. The maintainers provide Python examples for fixed or random placement and examples that analyse the resulting models in Python and MATLAB. JSON outputs list equations, known and unknown variables, and faults. The repository also supplies original and simplified L-TOWN networks, a node-name mapping, and simulated measurements in XLSX with YAML event configurations. These are benchmark systems, not a current geographic inventory. Temporal coverage and sampling intervals are not stated in the README. The package and assets are publicly available through GitHub under EUPL-1.2, without a fee. Simulation uses include comparing fault diagnosability and sensor-placement choices before detailed operational evaluation. The resource connects model-epanet with the L-TOWN network in data-battledim-leakage-detection-benchmark. Structural relations describe possible dependencies, not calibrated physical responses. The review checked documentation and metadata but did not install the package or verify that each example runs.
